candidate.answerReason: The complement is 30 degrees and the supplement is 120 degrees, so the complement is 25% of the supplement.

methods.label: Use equal parts
methods.explanation:
The supplement of an angle is always \(180^\circ-90^\circ=90^\circ\) greater than its complement. Also, \(25\%=\frac14\), so the supplement is four times the complement.

Think of the complement as one part and the supplement as four equal parts. Their difference is three parts, so each part measures
\[
90^\circ\div3=30^\circ.
\]
The complement is therefore \(30^\circ\), and the requested angle measures
\[
90^\circ-30^\circ=60^\circ.
\]
Its supplement is \(120^\circ\), and \(30\) is one quarter of \(120\). Thus the answer is \(\boxed{60^\circ}\), choice B.
